_help: Launch Budget Planner settings. lines: each budget line with a typical range as a percent of the raise (min and max). These ranges are rough starting points drafted for web3.toys, not quotes or sourced figures: check them with people who have launched (review stays true until you have) and change them freely. templates: starting splits (each adds up to 100) with a raise and a monthly team cost. runway: months counted as short (red) and healthy (green). warnings: the messages, with {placeholders} filled in.
note: Typical ranges are rough guides, not quotes. Real costs depend on your project, chain and partners.

warnings.notHundred: The lines add up to {total}%, not 100%.
warnings.noAudit: No money for an audit. Buyers and exchanges look for one.
warnings.noLegal: No money for legal advice. Token launches have legal risks in most countries.
warnings.hype: Marketing and KOLs take {pct}% of the raise, more than the team building the product.
warnings.shortRunway: Only {months} months of runway. Aim for at least {limit}.
warnings.noBurn: Add a monthly team cost to see your runway.
warnings.allGood: No big gaps by these rules. That does not make the plan right for your project.
